Im Fal- le der Säumnis ist der Vertragspartner verpflichtet, neben den Verzugszinsen auch alle sonsti- gen zweckentsprechenden prozessualen und außerprozessualen – gegenüber Verbrauchern tarifmäßigen – Kosten der Einbringlichmachung, auch die Kosten eines von Bauer-Poseidon beigezogenen Rechtsanwaltes, zu ersetzen. Darüber hinaus ist Bauer-Poseidon berechtigt, die Erfüllung ihrer eigenen Verpflichtungen bis zur Begleichung der rückständigen Zahlungen auf- zuschieben, eine angemessene Verlängerung der Lieferfrist in Anspruch zu nehmen, oder unter Einräumung einer angemessenen Nachfrist den Rücktritt vom Vertrag zu erklären. Im Fall des Rücktritts vom Vertrag hat der Vertragspartner über Aufforderung von Bauer-Poseidon bereits gelieferte Waren zurückzustellen und Bauer-Poseidon Ersatz für die eingetretene Wertminde- rung der Waren zu leisten sowie alle gerechtfertigten Aufwendungen zu erstatten, die Bauer- Poseidon für die Durchführung des Vertrages hatte.

Falls die Lieferung am vereinbarten Termin aus Gründen, die der Vertragspartner zu verant- worten hat, nicht stattfinden kann, gerät dieser in Annahmeverzug. Spätestens zu diesem Zeit- punkt gehen Gefahr und Kosten auf den Vertragspartner über. Darüber hinaus ist Bauer- Poseidon berechtigt, den Vertragsgegenstand nach ihrer Wahl zu versenden oder in beliebiger Weise im Namen und auf Rechnung des Vertragspartners einzulagern. Mit diesem Zeitpunkt gilt der Vertragsgegenstand als in jeder Hinsicht vertragsgemäß geliefert. Der Vertragspartner ist verpflichtet, die für den Fall der Lieferung fälligen oder durch die Lieferung bedingten Zahlungen unverzüglich zu leisten.

Die Prozess-Key-User haben dabei eine interdisziplinär führende Rolle und werden von den fachlichen Key-Usern bei der Umsetzung unterstützt. Insbe­ sondere die Key-User werden in Zusam­ menarbeit mit der Personalentwicklung die Schulung der User übernehmen. Neben der Software wurde auch er- heblich in Hardware investiert. Was wurde alles gemacht? Unsere IT-Infrastruktur ist heute schon eine andere wie noch vor sechs Monaten. Beispielsweise haben wir in neue Hardware investiert, auf der wir ca. 60 virtuelle Server abbilden – 30 da­ von als ERP-Server, 30 als Nicht-ERP- Server. Ebenso wurde die Bandbreite der Internetverbindung zwischen den Standorten erheblich ausgebaut und die Verteilungskomponenten modernisiert. Mit den geleisteten Investitionen ist un­ sere IT auf einem State-of-the-Art-Level. Wann soll GoLive sein? Im Juli 2020 wollen wir auf das neue System umschalten. Bis dahin stellen wir sicher, dass die Systeme, die Daten und die User dafür bereit sind.

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:
Compressor delivery rate (l/min): Air consumption of the specific application
Pressure differential between start and stop (hysteresis): Simplified formula for sizing a high-pressure storage system (based on 4 load cycles/hour):

The B-SAFE 300 is a fully enclosed high-pressure filling chamber designed for the simultaneous filling of up to ten breathing air cylinders at pressures of up to 410 bar. Its rugged design and lateral pressure relief ensure maximum safety – without requiring additional protective measures in the room. Operation is via a touchscreen control panel, optionally with a proportional valve for standards-compliant filling of lightweight cylinders.: The B-SAFE ECO is a compact safety chamber designed for direct compressor connection, offering maximum safety with minimal space requirements. Equipped with a mechanical door lock, modern venting technology, and internal pressure relief, it is ideal for container-based and stationary installations. It accommodates up to six breathing air cylinders.
Safety cell: The B-SAFE features an extremely robust steel safety cell that reliably protects against the consequences of bursting cylinders or rupturing filling hoses. Controlled air release to the housing side reduces the risk for operators. Both versions are portable and suitable for mobile use in vehicles. Forklift recesses on all housing sides enable easy handling.
Safety doors: The explosion-proof doors of the B-SAFE reliably secure the filling area. On the B-SAFE 300, the lock engages automatically during filling to prevent incorrect operation. The B-SAFE ECO is equipped with a mechanical safety lock that also prevents opening during operation.
Filling control: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Filling options: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Options: Proportional valve

The B-SAFE 300 is a fully enclosed high-pressure filling chamber designed for the simultaneous filling of up to ten breathing air cylinders at pressures of up to 410 bar. Its rugged design and lateral pressure relief ensure maximum safety – without requiring additional protective measures in the room. Operation is via a touchscreen control panel, optionally with a proportional valve for standards-compliant filling of lightweight cylinders.: The B-SAFE ECO is a compact safety chamber designed for direct compressor connection, offering maximum safety with minimal space requirements. Equipped with a mechanical door lock, modern venting technology, and internal pressure relief, it is ideal for container-based and stationary installations. It accommodates up to six breathing air cylinders.
Safety cell: The B-SAFE features an extremely robust steel safety cell that reliably protects against the consequences of bursting cylinders or rupturing filling hoses. Controlled air release to the housing side reduces the risk for operators. Both versions are portable and suitable for mobile use in vehicles. Forklift recesses on all housing sides enable easy handling.
Safety doors: The explosion-proof doors of the B-SAFE reliably secure the filling area. On the B-SAFE 300, the lock engages automatically during filling to prevent incorrect operation. The B-SAFE ECO is equipped with a mechanical safety lock that also prevents opening during operation.
Filling control: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Filling options: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:
Compressor delivery rate (l/min): Air consumption of the specific application
Pressure differential between start and stop (hysteresis): Simplified formula for sizing a high-pressure storage system (based on 4 load cycles/hour):

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:

The B-SAFE 300 is a fully enclosed high-pressure filling chamber designed for the simultaneous filling of up to ten breathing air cylinders at pressures of up to 410 bar. Its rugged design and lateral pressure relief ensure maximum safety – without requiring additional protective measures in the room. Operation is via a touchscreen control panel, optionally with a proportional valve for standards-compliant filling of lightweight cylinders.: The B-SAFE ECO is a compact safety chamber designed for direct compressor connection, offering maximum safety with minimal space requirements. Equipped with a mechanical door lock, modern venting technology, and internal pressure relief, it is ideal for container-based and stationary installations. It accommodates up to six breathing air cylinders.
Safety cell: The B-SAFE features an extremely robust steel safety cell that reliably protects against the consequences of bursting cylinders or rupturing filling hoses. Controlled air release to the housing side reduces the risk for operators. Both versions are portable and suitable for mobile use in vehicles. Forklift recesses on all housing sides enable easy handling.
Safety doors: The explosion-proof doors of the B-SAFE reliably secure the filling area. On the B-SAFE 300, the lock engages automatically during filling to prevent incorrect operation. The B-SAFE ECO is equipped with a mechanical safety lock that also prevents opening during operation.
Filling control: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Filling options: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Options: Proportional valve
Footnotes: 6 to 10 filling connections available

Wird die Luft unter diese Tempera­ tur abgekühlt, beginnt der Wasserdampf zu kondensieren und es bildet sich Tau (= flüssiges Wasser). Deshalb spricht man hier vom Taupunkt. Wird dieser bei einem höheren Druck als dem atmosphärischen Druck ge­ messen, dann spricht man vom Drucktaupunkt. Diese Unterscheidung ist wichtig, weil sich mit Änderung des Drucks und/oder der Temperatur auch der Taupunkt ändert. Zum besseren Verständnis: Ein abgeschlossenes Luftvolumen reduziert sich unter steigendem Druck. Wird es beispielsweise von 1 bar auf 10 bar kom­ primiert, dann nimmt das Volumen auf 1/10 ab. Das bedeutet, bei gleicher Temperatur kann komprimierte Luft weniger Was­ serdampf aufnehmen als im nichtkomprimierten Zustand. Im Umkehr­ schluss muss komprimierte Luft durch ein Filtersystem entsprechend stär­ ker entfeuchtet werden als Luft unter atmosphärischen Bedingungen, damit die Feuchte beispielsweise nicht in ein Rohrleitungssystem oder eine Tauch­ flasche gelangen kann. Sobald die Luft so trocken ist, dass die enthaltene Feuchte erst unter 0°C zu Eis gefriert, spricht man vom Frostpunkt und nicht mehr vom Taupunkt. Heinz Bauer

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:
Compressor delivery rate (l/min): Air consumption of the specific application
Pressure differential between start and stop (hysteresis): Simplified formula for sizing a high-pressure storage system (based on 4 load cycles/hour):

Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
The size of the storage system depends on:
Air consumption of the specific application
Simplified formula for sizing a high-pressure storage system (based on 4 load cycles/hour):
V (l): Storage volume in liters (water volume)

We recommend a pressure differential Δp of max. 60 bar for continuous operation. Within this range, stationary high-pressure storage cylinders are typically rated for continuous duty. For higher differentials, the number of allowable filling cycles is limited. Please refer to the documentation for the specific pressure vessel.

Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation

To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.

The B-SAFE 300 is a fully enclosed high-pressure filling chamber designed for the simultaneous filling of up to ten breathing air cylinders at pressures of up to 410 bar. Its rugged design and lateral pressure relief ensure maximum safety – without requiring additional protective measures in the room. Operation is via a touchscreen control panel, optionally with a proportional valve for standards-compliant filling of lightweight cylinders.: The B-SAFE ECO is a compact safety chamber designed for direct compressor connection, offering maximum safety with minimal space requirements. Equipped with a mechanical door lock, modern venting technology, and internal pressure relief, it is ideal for container-based and stationary installations. It accommodates up to six breathing air cylinders.
Safety cell: The B-SAFE features an extremely robust steel safety cell that reliably protects against the consequences of bursting cylinders or rupturing filling hoses. Controlled air release to the housing side reduces the risk for operators. Both versions are portable and suitable for mobile use in vehicles. Forklift recesses on all housing sides enable easy handling.
Safety doors: The explosion-proof doors of the B-SAFE reliably secure the filling area. On the B-SAFE 300, the lock engages automatically during filling to prevent incorrect operation. The B-SAFE ECO is equipped with a mechanical safety lock that also prevents opening during operation.
Filling control: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Filling options: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.

The B-SAFE 300 is a fully enclosed high-pressure filling chamber designed for the simultaneous filling of up to ten breathing air cylinders at pressures of up to 410 bar. Its rugged design and lateral pressure relief ensure maximum safety – without requiring additional protective measures in the room. Operation is via a touchscreen control panel, optionally with a proportional valve for standards-compliant filling of lightweight cylinders.: The B-SAFE ECO is a compact safety chamber designed for direct compressor connection, offering maximum safety with minimal space requirements. Equipped with a mechanical door lock, modern venting technology, and internal pressure relief, it is ideal for container-based and stationary installations. It accommodates up to six breathing air cylinders.
Safety cell: The B-SAFE features an extremely robust steel safety cell that reliably protects against the consequences of bursting cylinders or rupturing filling hoses. Controlled air release to the housing side reduces the risk for operators. Both versions are portable and suitable for mobile use in vehicles. Forklift recesses on all housing sides enable easy handling.
Safety doors: The explosion-proof doors of the B-SAFE reliably secure the filling area. On the B-SAFE 300, the lock engages automatically during filling to prevent incorrect operation. The B-SAFE ECO is equipped with a mechanical safety lock that also prevents opening during operation.
Filling control: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Filling options: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.

Intermediate pressure gauge Analog pressure gauges are installed at appropriate points of the compressor system and allow for easy monitoring of operating pressures. Das Entstehen einer Gewährleistungspflicht hat eine fachge- rechte Ausführung des Einbaus der Geräte und weiteren Lie- fergegenstände von BAUER zur Voraussetzung. Die Gewähr- leistungspflicht erlischt, wenn die gelieferten Waren von frem- der Seite verändert, Teile fremder Herkunft eingebaut oder für den Betrieb, die Instandhaltung oder die Instandsetzung an- dere als Original-Ersatzteile, -Schmierstoffe und -Verbrauchs- materialien im Sinne von Ziffer XI 1. dieser AGB verwendet werden. Sie erlischt ebenso, wenn der Kunde Vorschriften zur Inbetriebnahme missachtet und dadurch ein Mangel hervorge- rufen wird.

Die Gewährleistungsfrist beträgt ein Jahr ab Gefahrübergang. Die Regelung über die Verjährung von Rückgriffsansprüchen des Unternehmers gegen den Lieferanten aus §§ 478, 479 BGB bleibt in allen Fällen unberührt.

VARIATION IN RATE OF CUSTOMS DUTY Wherever, the price includes landed cost (CIF cost in Rupees plus current rate of customs duty and clearing charges in Rupees) of imported components, any increase in selling price due to an upward revision in the rate of customs duty shall be to the Buyer's account.

VARIATION IN RATE OF EXCHANGE Quotation is based on the present rate of exchange between the Indian Rupee and the currency of the country from which the goods/parts/components are to be imported. Any loss suffered by BKI as a result of fluctuation in rate of exchange at the time of remittance will be to the account of the Buyer.

SPECIFICATIONS A) The information as regards specifications of Goods given in the Quotation or in any of BKI's publications, drawing, literature etc. is only intended to present a general idea of the Goods offered for sale. They are not binding on BKI in all minute details. The specifications are subject to modifications without notice. B) Performance parameters are subject to tolerances e.g. ± 5% for flow rate, power, pressure, rpm and ± 10% for net weight and dimensions. C) BKI also reserves the right to make changes in the design of components or material which in BKI's judgement are necessary or which are necessitated by the non-availability of raw materials/components etc.

6 Je abgelegener und unzugänglicher das Ziel ist, desto größer die Rolle, die Handling und 100 % zuverlässiger Betrieb zum Gelingen beitragen. Erste Wahl sind hier meist die „Trag- baren“ von BAUER, allen voran der über Jahrzehnte erprobte JUNIOR II. Kann die Anlage - beispielsweise auf einem Schiff - stationär betrieben werden, und werden größere Mengen an Luft benötigt, kommen gerne mobilen Anlagen wie MARINER und die PE-TE-Reihe zum Einsatz. Sie bestechen durch eine Kombination aus großer Liefermenge und kompak- ten Abmessungen.

Beseitigt der Vertragspartner die von ihm zu vertretenden Umstände, die eine Verzögerung verursacht haben, nicht innerhalb einer ihm von Bauer-Poseidon angemessen gesetzten Frist, ist diese berechtigt, über die von ihr zur Leistungsausführung bereits beigeschafften Materialien und Geräte anderweitig zu verfügen; im Falle der Fortsetzung der Leistungsausführung verlän- gern sich dann alle Fristen und Termine auch um den Zeitraum, den die Nachschaffung dieser anderweitig verwendeten Geräte und Materialien erfordert.

Bei einer von Bauer-Poseidon zu vertretenden Überschreitung einer vereinbarten Lieferfrist ist der Vertragspartner berechtigt, unter Setzung einer Nachfrist von 14 Tagen mittels einge- schriebenen Briefes vom Vertrag hinsichtlich aller noch nicht gelieferter Waren zurückzutreten. VII. Abnahmeprüfung:

Sofern der Vertragspartner eine Abnahmeprüfung wünscht, ist diese mit Bauer-Poseidon ausdrücklich bei Vertragsabschluß in schriftlicher Form zu vereinbaren. Soweit keine abwei- chenden Regelungen getroffen werden, ist dabei die Abnahmeprüfung am Herstellungsort oder an einem von Bauer-Poseidon zu bestimmenden Ort während der normalen Arbeitszeit von Bauer-Poseidon durchzuführen. Dabei ist die für die Abnahmeprüfung allgemeine Praxis des betreffenden Industriezweiges maßgeblich.

Einmal live mitzuerleben, wie der eigene BAUER Kompressor vom Rohgussteil bis zur fertigen Anlage entsteht, war schon lange der Wunsch des fernsehbekann- ten Nordseetauchers Andi Peters. Schließlich verlässt er sich während sei- ner anspruchsvollen Expeditionen seit Anbeginn seiner Karriere vor 20 Jahren auf Atemluft des Marktführers bei Tauchsportverdichtern. Und in der BAUER Akademie waren zwei Plätze in einem Kompressorwartungskurs für ihn und seinen Teamkollegen Thomas Reim re- serviert. 1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal addition to compressor systems and ensures a stable pressure supply for air and gas applications. Available in pressure stages of 330 bar and 420 bar, it reduces pressure fluctuations during peak demand and reduces the frequency of compressor start-ups. Flexible expansion with 50- or 80-litre storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to requirements and supports smooth, efficient system operation.: Storage cylinder with console
A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.: Pressure vessel
The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.: Condensate drain
Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.: Options
Safety valve and pressure gauge: Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.
The storage design: Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation
A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.: To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. Flexible expansion with 50- or 80-litre storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to requirements and supports smooth, efficient system operation.: Storage cylinder with console

The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.: Condensate drain
Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.: Options
Safety valve and pressure gauge: Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.

A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.: To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. Needless to say, the JUNOR performed its service reliably, allowing for the success of the expedition. The JUNIOR then went on tour to Norway: A long planned, six-person diving team expedition from the tech magazine “Wetnotes.” A narrow three-week window was open in August to complete a tight program of almost a dozen exploratory dives to various ship and aircraft wrecks from the Narvik area to the Lofoten islands. A BAUER system was chosen for the air supply. Here in the Arctic Circle there are often harsh conditi- ons, even in summer, and the water temperature rarely rises above 12°C. Clean, dry breathing air is extremely important here, as moisture can quickly lead to life- threatening icing on diving regula- tors during cold water dives. Thanks to its low weight and compact dimensions, the JUNIOR fit perfectly on the trailer. The gasoline drive allowed the team to have a comple- tely self-sufficient air supply directly on the pier next to the boat. Almost all of the targeted destinations were successfully dived. The first of several exciting articles about the dives will be published in the January issue, No. 51. 7 Thanks to the trolley and petrol drive, the bottles can be filled directly on the boat at the pier.

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:
Compressor delivery rate (l/min): Air consumption of the specific application
Pressure differential between start and stop (hysteresis): Simplified formula for sizing a high-pressure storage system (based on 4 load cycles/hour):
Vk (l/min): Compressor delivery volume in liters per minute: V (l): Storage volume in liters (water volume)
Δp (bar): Pressure differential (hysteresis) in bar: We recommend a pressure differential Δp of max. 60 bar for continuous operation. Within this range, stationary high-pressure storage cylinders are typically rated for continuous duty. For higher differentials, the number of allowable filling cycles is limited. Please refer to the documentation for the specific pressure vessel.

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:

Δp (bar): Pressure differential (hysteresis) in bar: We recommend a pressure differential Δp of max. 60 bar for continuous operation. Within this range, stationary high-pressure storage cylinders are typically rated for continuous duty. For higher differentials, the number of allowable filling cycles is limited. Please refer to the documentation for the specific pressure vessel.

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design

What is the G22 series used for in helium applications? The G22 series comprises air-cooled high-pressure compressors for industrial helium compression. 1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:
Compressor delivery rate (l/min): Air consumption of the specific application
Pressure differential between start and stop (hysteresis): Simplified formula for sizing a high-pressure storage system (based on 4 load cycles/hour):

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:
Compressor delivery rate (l/min): Air consumption of the specific application
Pressure differential between start and stop (hysteresis): Simplified formula for sizing a high-pressure storage system (based on 4 load cycles/hour):

The modular storage system is the ideal addition to compressor systems and ensures a stable pressure supply for air and gas applications. Flexible expansion with 50- or 80-litre storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to requirements and supports smooth, efficient system operation.: Storage cylinder with console
A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.: Pressure vessel
The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.: Condensate drain
Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.: Options

The storage design: Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation
A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.: To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.

1 Underwater photographer Thomas Friedrich and his partner, Patricia Guar- diola Rico, have a dream that is probab- ly shared by many other divers – with the difference that they are making theirs come true. The couple is embar- king on a motorhome tour and exploring the best underwater diving spots along the way in the company of well-known locals. They’ll meet free diver Phil Sima to visit the Verzasca granite labyrinth and join shark expert Isaias Cruz in Bil- bao to encounter Atlantic blue and mako sharks. Further destinations along their route will be the caves and caverns at Alicante, the colourful gorgonian forests off the Costa Brava, and Second World War submarine wrecks at Marseilles. Their journey will be a celebration of freedom and independence. Many of the dives will be in remote areas. Here they naturally need an onboard supply of pure breathing air which is safe, relia- ble and – most important of all – inde- pendent of a mains power source. The solution is a petrol-driven mobile BAUER compressor. The brand-new PE200-TB from the POSEIDON EDITION series, with its sleek new fan protector, is good-looking and much more besides; the iconic design also optimizes the cooling air flow, making the compressor Over the past six months, the co- ronavirus pandemic has plunged us into an exceptional situation that is a huge challenge for us all. However, by introducing strict hy- giene and protective measures at an early stage and combining them with mobile working and

system monitors breathing air and Nitrox in real time according to DIN EN 12021:2014. It measures CO, CO₂, O₂, humidity, and VOCs, and protects with automatic shutdown in case of limit exceedance. The CO ping test checks sensors before start. With B-CLOUD, digital documentation and remote access are possible. Optionally, contaminated air can be vented automatically outdoors. B-CLOUD & B-APP With BAUER B-CLOUD and the B-APP, users can keep an eye on their compressor system at all times, even remotely. Operating data, maintenance instructions, and status messages are transmitted and visualized in real time. This increases transparency, simplifies monitoring, and supports optimized maintenance planning. In addition, the stored operating data in the B-CLOUD is available for later analysis and system performance optimization. B-LINK Wi-Fi and 4G routers enable the wireless communication of the B-CONTROL MICRO with the B-CLOUD. They establish a reliable Wi-Fi or mobile network connection, allowing secure remote access to the compressor system. B-SECURUS filter monitoring The B-SECURUS system monitors the saturation of the filter cartridge(s) by measuring the moisture level in the molecular sieve and provides a timely indication when a cartridge replacement is required – either on the display or via the control unit. Once saturation is reached, the system automatically shuts down the unit. The B-SECURUS filter monitoring system can only be used in conjunction with the P 41, P 61,

If the system can be operated from a stationary ship and larger quantities of air are required, mobile systems such as the MARINER and PE-TE series are often used. What is the G22 series used for in helium applications? The G22 series comprises air-cooled high-pressure compressors for industrial helium compression. Most comprehensive air and gas treatment portfolio: From separators and regenerative and adsorption dryers to refrigerated dryers, BAUER covers all air and gas purity requirements in accordance with DIN ISO 8573-1. Global market leadership & service expertise: BAUER is the global market standard in high- and medium-pressure applications across nearly all segments – with a 70% market share in breathing air systems and an undisputed leading position in industrial applications, supported by a global service network. What is the G22 series used for in helium applications? The G22 series comprises air-cooled high-pressure compressors for industrial helium compression. It is used wherever helium needs to be reliably compressed from atmospheric pressure to high final pressures or reprocessed within recovery systems, for example in industrial processes, research facilities, test benches and gas recovery plants. What performance ranges does the G22 series cover for helium? Depending on the configuration, the high-pressure versions of the G22 series achieve final pressures of up to 350 bar. The effective delivery rates range from approximately 620 to 1,500 litres per minute, depending on the model. This makes the series suitable for both compact helium applications and high-capacity recovery and supply systems. How are the G22 high-pressure compressors controlled and monitored? The compressors are equipped with the B-CONTROL MICRO control system.

Kompressorsteuerung B-CONTROL SMART Die B-CONTROL SMART ist eine leistungsstarke Kompressorsteuerung mit erweitertem Funktionsumfang, viel Speicher und IoT-Konnektivität via B-CLOUD. Sie unterstützt den Verbundbetrieb und bietet hohe Performance für anspruchsvolle Anwendungen. Wahlweise mit 3,5" Farbdisplay oder 7" Touchscreen ermöglicht sie intuitive Bedienung und sicheren Fernzugriff – eine zukunftssichere Lösung. System design The directly coupled compressor units are equipped with vibration dampers and are suitable for installation without a special foundation. The air-cooled compressor is designed for efficient heat dissipation and easy maintenance. The direct coupling provides reliable, low-maintenance power transmission between the electric motor and compressor. The automatic condensate drain ensures continuous operation by efficiently removing condensate. Compressor block Our air-cooled compressor blocks come equipped with intercoolers, an aftercooler, an oil and water separator after each compression stage, and a reliable forced-feed oil lubrication system. They provide the foundation for fully automated systems designed to compress air and gases at either atmospheric or elevated intake pressures. Oversized coolers and ribbed cylinders ensure effective heat dissipation. Ultra-fine oil filters, extended maintenance intervals, and dynamically balanced drive systems contribute to high efficiency, reliability, and smooth, low-vibration performance.

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:

Die Reduzierung des Druckverlusts führt je nach Anlagentyp im Dauerlauf zu einem entsprechenden Liefermengengewinn sowie Energieeinsparung. Herzstück der neuen B-DRAIN ist das Kondensatven- til, das als Druckminderer wirkt: Der Betriebsdruck im Kondensatabscheider reduziert sich von bis zu 550 bar auf 2 bis 9 bar Steuerdruck. Beim Start des Kompressors (Anlage drucklos) ist das Kondensatventil offen. Das Magnetventil (1) wird geschlossen. Mit dem Druckaufbau des Kompres- sors baut sich auch der Steuerdruck unterhalb des Kolbens (2) auf. Dadurch wird der Kolben aufgrund der Flächenverhältnisse nach oben geschoben und damit das Kondensatventil geschlossen. Zum Kondensatablass wird das Magnetventil geöffnet. Dadurch bricht der Steuerdruck ein und der Kolben wird durch den Betriebsdruck an der Fläche (3) sowie durch die Kraft der Feder (4) nach unten gedrückt. Das Kondensat fließt nun über den Kolben und durch das Magnet­ventil aus dem Kondensatventil. Im Mag- netventil ist eine Drossel (5), die einen erneuten Anstieg des Steu- erdrucks bewirkt. Dieser Steuerdruck schließt den Kolben so weit, bis sich ein Kräftegleichgewicht ergibt. Der ­Abströmdruck des Kondensats bzw. der Druckluft ist damit vom Betriebsdruck weitgehend entkop- pelt. Herzstück der neuen B-DRAIN ist das Kondensatven- til, das als Druckminderer wirkt: Der Betriebsdruck im Kondensatabscheider reduziert sich von bis zu 550 bar auf 2 bis 9 bar Steuerdruck. Beim Start des Kompressors (Anlage drucklos) ist das Kondensatventil offen. Das Magnetventil (1) wird geschlossen. Mit dem Druckaufbau des Kompres- sors baut sich auch der Steuerdruck unterhalb des Kolbens (2) auf. Dadurch wird der Kolben aufgrund der Flächenverhältnisse nach oben geschoben und damit das Kondensatventil geschlossen. Zum Kondensatablass wird das Magnetventil geöffnet. Dadurch bricht der Steuerdruck ein und der Kolben wird durch den Betriebsdruck an der Fläche (3) sowie durch die Kraft der Feder (4) nach unten gedrückt. Das Kondensat fließt nun über den Kolben und durch das Magnet­ventil aus dem Kondensatventil. Im Mag- netventil ist eine Drossel (5), die einen erneuten Anstieg des Steu- erdrucks bewirkt. The B-SAFE 300 is a fully enclosed high-pressure filling chamber designed for the simultaneous filling of up to ten breathing air cylinders at pressures of up to 410 bar. Its rugged design and lateral pressure relief ensure maximum safety – without requiring additional protective measures in the room. Operation is via a touchscreen control panel, optionally with a proportional valve for standards-compliant filling of lightweight cylinders.: The B-SAFE ECO is a compact safety chamber designed for direct compressor connection, offering maximum safety with minimal space requirements. Equipped with a mechanical door lock, modern venting technology, and internal pressure relief, it is ideal for container-based and stationary installations. It accommodates up to six breathing air cylinders.
Safety cell: The B-SAFE features an extremely robust steel safety cell that reliably protects against the consequences of bursting cylinders or rupturing filling hoses. Controlled air release to the housing side reduces the risk for operators. Both versions are portable and suitable for mobile use in vehicles. Forklift recesses on all housing sides enable easy handling.
Safety doors: The explosion-proof doors of the B-SAFE reliably secure the filling area. On the B-SAFE 300, the lock engages automatically during filling to prevent incorrect operation. The B-SAFE ECO is equipped with a mechanical safety lock that also prevents opening during operation.
Filling control: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Filling options: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.

The B-SAFE 300 is a fully enclosed high-pressure filling chamber designed for the simultaneous filling of up to ten breathing air cylinders at pressures of up to 410 bar. Its rugged design and lateral pressure relief ensure maximum safety – without requiring additional protective measures in the room. Operation is via a touchscreen control panel, optionally with a proportional valve for standards-compliant filling of lightweight cylinders.: The B-SAFE ECO is a compact safety chamber designed for direct compressor connection, offering maximum safety with minimal space requirements. Equipped with a mechanical door lock, modern venting technology, and internal pressure relief, it is ideal for container-based and stationary installations. It accommodates up to six breathing air cylinders.
Safety cell: The B-SAFE features an extremely robust steel safety cell that reliably protects against the consequences of bursting cylinders or rupturing filling hoses. Controlled air release to the housing side reduces the risk for operators. Both versions are portable and suitable for mobile use in vehicles. Forklift recesses on all housing sides enable easy handling.
Safety doors: The explosion-proof doors of the B-SAFE reliably secure the filling area. On the B-SAFE 300, the lock engages automatically during filling to prevent incorrect operation. The B-SAFE ECO is equipped with a mechanical safety lock that also prevents opening during operation.
Filling control: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Filling options: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.

With their robust design, intuitive user interfaces, and flexible software solutions, fuel terminals provide an efficient solution for companies and operators looking to digitalize and optimize their fueling processes.

The high-pressure gas treatment system (high-pressure filter) is installed on the discharge side of the compressor and reliably removes excess moisture as well as potential oil residues from the natural gas.
With decades of experience in air and gas treatment, BAUER guarantees the highest quality – ensuring safe, optimally conditioned natural gas for the refueling process and on the road.

The B-SAFE 300 is a fully enclosed high-pressure filling chamber designed for the simultaneous filling of up to ten breathing air cylinders at pressures of up to 410 bar. Its rugged design and lateral pressure relief ensure maximum safety – without requiring additional protective measures in the room. Operation is via a touchscreen control panel, optionally with a proportional valve for standards-compliant filling of lightweight cylinders.: The B-SAFE ECO is a compact safety chamber designed for direct compressor connection, offering maximum safety with minimal space requirements. Equipped with a mechanical door lock, modern venting technology, and internal pressure relief, it is ideal for container-based and stationary installations. It accommodates up to six breathing air cylinders.
Safety cell: The B-SAFE features an extremely robust steel safety cell that reliably protects against the consequences of bursting cylinders or rupturing filling hoses. Controlled air release to the housing side reduces the risk for operators. Both versions are portable and suitable for mobile use in vehicles. Forklift recesses on all housing sides enable easy handling.
Safety doors: The explosion-proof doors of the B-SAFE reliably secure the filling area. On the B-SAFE 300, the lock engages automatically during filling to prevent incorrect operation. The B-SAFE ECO is equipped with a mechanical safety lock that also prevents opening during operation.
Filling control: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Filling options: The B-SAFE 300 is equipped with a user-friendly touchscreen control with plain text display of all operating parameters. The B-SAFE ECO is manually operated and equipped with three pressure gauges for pressure control. Both versions provide safe and efficient control of the filling process.
Options: Proportional valve

The terminals support various identification and payment methods such as chip cards, PIN codes, or contactless media, ensuring transparency and control during the refueling process. With their robust design, intuitive user interfaces, and flexible software solutions, fuel terminals provide an efficient solution for companies and operators looking to digitalize and optimize their fueling processes.
